I wrote the solution in `main.wj`. It builds with `wj build` and gives the right output on the cases I ran with `wj run --compiled`.

Those cases were both examples, a blank line, and a non-leap-year 29 February (`2023-02-29`, which printed `invalid`). I ran no other inputs.
